entries.wording: Empty container dispatched from inland point to Customer
entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container to load it, from a depot or the port; the cargo is not yet with Gold Star Line.

entries.wording: Export gate-in from Customer to Port of Loading
entries.note: The loaded container enters the port of loading. After a move it reads as transit.

entries.wording: Container was loaded at Port of Loading to Port of Discharge
Container was loaded at Port of Loading to Transshipment Port
Container was discharged at Transshipment Port
Container was loaded at Transsihipment Port to Port of Discharge
Container was discharged at Port of Destination
Barge was loaded at Port of Loading to Port of Discharge
entries.note: A feeder barge's loading, as for a short sea leg.

entries.wording: Barge was discharged at Port of Discharge
Container is available to be released / delivered
entries.note: The consignee's trucker may collect the container at the port of discharge.

entries.wording: Import Gate-Out from Port of Discharge to Customer
entries.note: The consignee takes the loaded container from the port.

entries.wording: Import truck departure from Port of Discharge to Customer
entries.note: The consignee's trucker collects the loaded container for delivery.
The consignee unloaded the container and returned it empty. Before the container moved, it is an unused one and has no stage.

entries.wording: Empty container gate in by Truck
entries.note: The consignee unloaded the container and returned it empty by truck. Before the container moved, it is an unused one and has no stage.
The line releases the cargo to the consignee, often before it arrives: a notice, not a move.
Customs cleared the cargo, often before it arrives: a notice, not a move.
